name: iism-form-filler
description: Personal Chrome extension that autofills the IISM Gulmarg admission form from a local profile. Never submits.

scripts.build: vite build && esbuild src/background/service-worker.ts --bundle --format=esm --target=es2022 --outfile=dist/background/service-worker.js && esbuild src/content/index.ts --bundle --format=iife --target=es2022 --outfile=dist/content/index.js
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run build
